items.why: The fear gauge is spiking as the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all slip at the open ahead of a pivotal week for AI.
Tech stocks are sliding as Nvidia drama continues to unfold, pulling chip names down with the Nasdaq.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Tech stocks are sliding into a pivotal week for AI, and Google is caught in the broad selloff as Nvidia tests loom.

market_note: Futures were already weak before the open, with the Nasdaq future down about 2.2% and the S&P future down about 1.3%.
summary: Stocks are sharply lower Monday morning, with the Nasdaq leading the slide as Nvidia drama and AI worries weigh on tech. The VIX is spiking as investors brace for a pivotal week for AI.
